source_text: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) recommends that healthcare providers inform adolescent and adult males, as well as parents of newborn boys, about the substantial evidence that male circumcision reduces the risk of HIV acquisition during heterosexual sex by approximately 60%, alongside benefits against other sexually transmitted infections; the CDC supports voluntary access without endorsing mandates. [65]
